name: Your Glove Source
old_description: First time customers get $5.00 off your first order over $35.00, using Discount code FTC.
about:
Your Glove Source operates from Tijeras, New Mexico. The company's founding year and ownership structure are not publicly disclosed.

The business functions as a distributor and online retailer of hand protection products, offering a broad selection of disposable and reusable gloves sourced from established brands such as MaxiFlex, Gloveworks, Samurai, Ice Gripster, and G‑Tek. Its catalog spans nitrile, latex, vinyl, and cut‑resistant Dyneema gloves, sold in quantities ranging from single boxes to 1,000‑glove cases. The site also features a clearance section for discounted, discontinued, or damaged goods.

Customers come from medical and dental offices, food‑service and restaurant operations, automotive and general manufacturing shops, tattoo studios, and construction crews. The product lineup includes exam‑grade nitrile and latex gloves, food‑service vinyl gloves, heavy‑duty nitrile work gloves, and ANSI‑rated cut‑resistant models for industrial use.

The company promotes competitive pricing, free shipping on select case orders, and a first‑order discount for new buyers.
